Unpack+pack formats ARE already reconfigured at cull->blend boundary yet bug persists -> residual hazard is below format-reconfig (SrcA/DEST bank reuse / DEST full-sync / SFPU LREG). Clean fix init_sfpu()/unary_op_init_common mid-kernel DEADLOCKS (re-runs UNPACK/PACK hw_configure with pending CBs; wedged device x2). BANKED, FUSE_BLEND gated OFF; needs LLK-level inter-phase pipeline reset OR ROUTE C (cull moved into sort program = separate programs, no shared config, also kills spin).
